prompt: Which is the highest waterfall in the world?
response: The highest waterfall in the world is Angel Falls (also known as Salto Ángel) in Venezuela. It has a height of 979 meters (3,212 feet) and a plunge of 807 meters (2,648 feet), with the remaining 172 meters (564 feet) extending beyond the main plunge in a series of smaller cascades and rapids. Angel Falls is located in the Canaima National Park within the Gran Sabana region of Bolívar State, Venezuela.
